title: Stable blowup profile for a semilinear heat equation with spatially inhomogeneous nonlinearity
summary: We study the focusing semilinear heat equation with an additional defocusing Hénon-type nonlinearity, the coupling of which is measured by a constant $c >0$. For $c \in (0,c^*)$, the model admits a closed-form self-similar blowup solution in every space dimension $d \geq 1$. Restricting ourselves to the three-dimensional case, we study the stability of this solution under small non-radial perturbations.
